text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: One, two♪ One, two♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan asked me to keep her company
for some independent dance practice today, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Click!)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Gooood morning☆
Here's Falco, full of energy today, dancing—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Curren-chan?!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Wah, hello~♪
Are you two doing self-practice as well,
Falco-san, Flash-san?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm just accompanying her. Though we are
already five seconds behind our scheduled start time.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Falcon-san?
Why are you standing frozen at the entrance?
We should avoid any further loss of time."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ah. Sorry... Err, well.
I just didn't expect you to be here, Curren-chan...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hawa... Am I, Curren, not allowed here~...?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not what I mean!
It's not that, it's just that when you're around—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It's just that Falco's heart
catches fire, that's all...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: That sounds lovely.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ehe, that's so true~♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see... Falco-san going all out, huh~
With Flash-san accompanying her—...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehe, decided♪ Curren wants to see Falco-san's
sharp dancing up close!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
If I can practice with the two of you,
I feel like Curren can dance with a real spark☆

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
So Curren wants to practice together...
No, even just watching from the side is fine.
Please...? *sniffle, teary eyes*

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (KABOOOOOOM!!)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...... Grasping everything in a single instant,
and striving to turn every experience
into a learning opportunity――

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: What a terrifying girl she is... Curren Chan.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Falcon-san.
Shall we start practice soon?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And with that...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Yes please, pretty please!
Falco-san♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Understood.
I accept your challenge—Curren-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Curren Chan and the others
danced, and danced, and danced on—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Reach into everyone's hearts!
This is Curren's love☆"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Kyurunâª

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...Impressive, Curren-chan.
To think you've mastered it to this extent...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, I got praised~.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Big Brother, did you think it was amazing too?
Curren's dancing, that is♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Big Sister, did you think it was amazing too?
Curren's dancing, that is♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan had mastered movements
sharper than ever before...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, you're right♪
Just watching can lead to growth, too—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...*glance*.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Learning about other people's perspectives
and ways of thinking is good study too, right?♪

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—Falcon-san,
the angle of your arm is three degrees too low.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Aaahn, Flash-san,
you're so strict~!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"However, you asked me to accompany you knowing full well what to expect, didn't you?
Look, your rhythm is off by 0.5 seconds again."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Wooww... Flash-san checks
every little detail, doesn't she?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Mhm, mhm, I see?
...Curren might get it now!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed Curren Chan had also learned something
from Eishin Flash's words and actions.
